title: The Forensic Investigation Workflow
description: A Mermaid flowchart of the digital forensic investigation process from identification and isolation through court disclosure, with two decision points and a parallel chain-of-custody log that every step writes to.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Sequence the steps of a digital forensic investigation from identification through court disclosure.
Explain why each step writes to the chain-of-custody log and why analysis is performed on a verified copy.
prerequisites: Basic idea of digital evidence and hashing

instructionalStrategies: Walk the flow top-down and hover each step; identify which steps are irreversible.
Discuss the two decision diamonds: the power decision and the hash-verification gate.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why is volatile data captured before forensic imaging of the disk?
What is the consequence at trial if the chain-of-custody log has a gap?
